import os, certifi, sys
# If you have a corporate CA, set it here (edit the path or delete the line):
os.environ.setdefault("REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE", r"C:\ProgramData\Python3\Lib\site-packages\certifi\cacert.pem")


# If you access intranet hosts directly, bypass proxy for them:
#os.environ.setdefault("NO_PROXY", "localhost,#127.0.0.1,.imf.org,ecnswn12p")

# Optional: quick diagnostics (first run only)
print("PY:", sys.executable)
print("CERTIFI:", certifi.where())
print("HTTPS_PROXY:", os.environ.get("HTTPS_PROXY"))
print("REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE:", os.environ.get("REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE"))
